summary.result: The principles, directions, and recommendations outlined in this study are anticipated to significantly contribute to the consistent and comprehensive reporting of the mitigation effects of policies and measures in the preparation of BTRs.
summary.background: The parties of the Paris Agreement are obligated to submit a Biennial Transparency Report (BTR) every two years, providing comprehensive information on the implementation of their efforts under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).
summary.method: In accordance with the Paris Agreement, technical reviews pertaining to specific details in each BTR are expected, building on experiences and lessons learned from the existing UNFCCC reporting and review system.
